Class XetraSecuritySearch

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.connector.securitysearch.BaseSecuritySearchProvider
grafioschtrader.connector.securitysearch.XetraSecuritySearch
All Implemented Interfaces:
ISecuritySearchProvider
@Component public class XetraSecuritySearch extends BaseSecuritySearchProvider
Searches the Xetra and Frankfurt listings of Deutsche Börse, without a key, in two steps:
  1. The TradingView search of Börse Frankfurt (tradingview/search) returns one entry per listing, with a symbol of the form MIC:ISIN (e.g. XETR:DE0007164600), the name and the instrument type. ISIN and MIC are therefore delivered.
  2. The search does not carry the trading currency. For the listings on the queried exchange - at most MAX_DETAIL_REQUESTS - the price information of the live API supplies it. When that request fails, the currency simply stays unknown; the listing is not dropped.
The provider symbol is the MIC:ISIN symbol of Börse Frankfurt.

Master data combines the search entry (name and instrument type Aktie, ETP or Anleihe) with the price information of the listing (currency, tradedInPercent, minimumTradableUnit). Deutsche Börse delivers no ticker. The stock exchange hyperlink is the listing page of Deutsche Börse with the ISIN in place of the name slug, e.g. https://live.deutsche-boerse.com/aktie/DE0007164600?mic=XETR; the site redirects it to the slug page.

The terms of a bond come from master_data_bond (maturity, first trading day, minimum investment amount, coupon, issuer), interest_rate_widget (coupon frequency as interestPaymentCycle) and data_sheet_header (WKN, which becomes the ticker, since a bond has no exchange ticker). These endpoints answer only requests signed the way the page's own script signs them: Client-Date is the local time of the request, X-Client-TraceId the MD5 of date, URL and a salt, X-Security the MD5 of the minute. The salt is read from the main script of the site and cached; an empty answer {} means a rejected signature and renews the salt once. A bond whose terms cannot be read keeps the master data of the price information.
